title: Manners of entering and leaving
intro: Right foot in, left foot out – and the bathroom the other way round.

items.label: Right foot IN – home, masjid, school, maktab
Left foot OUT – home, masjid, school, maktab

learn.html: We go into the bathroom with the left foot, and before going in we say:

learn.label: Before going into the bathroom
learn.ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْخُبُثِ وَالْخَبَائِثِ
learn.tr: Allaahumma innee a‘oodhu bika minal-khubuthi wal-khabaa’ith.
learn.en: O Allah, I seek refuge with You from the male and female devils. (Bukhari and Muslim)

learn.html: We come out with the right foot and then say:

learn.label: After coming out
learn.en: I ask Your forgiveness, my Lord. (Abu Dawud, Ibn Majah, Tirmidhi)

practice.title: Which foot first?
practice.prompt: Which foot do we use first?

questions.q: Which foot do we enter the masjid with?
Which foot do we enter the bathroom with?
What do we say after leaving the bathroom?
